title: Dynamic Regret for Non-Stationary Linear Bandits via Misspecification Reductions
abstract: arXiv:2607.02891v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many online decision-making problems involve both round-specific feasible actions and drifting reward models: eligible ad impressions, feasible prices, and available treatments can change over time, while user preferences, demand curves, and patient responses may evolve. Motivated by these applications, we study non-stationary linear bandits with round-specific feasible decision sets. Our key contribution is a blockwise reduction that connects parameter drift in non-stationary linear bandits to model misspecification in contextual linear bandits while preserving the round-specific decision benchmark. This connection allows us to leverage misspecification-adaptive learning to obtain dynamic-regret guarantees for general time-varying decision sets. translated_title: 基于误设定规约的非平稳线性老虎机动态遗憾研究
translated_abstract: 许多在线决策问题同时涉及特定轮次的可行动作和漂移的奖励模型：符合条件的广告展示、可行的价格以及可用的治疗方案会随时间变化，而用户偏好、需求曲线和患者反应也可能不断演变。受这些应用的启发，我们研究了具有特定轮次可行决策集的非平稳线性老虎机问题。我们的关键贡献是一种分块规约方法，它在保留特定轮次决策基准的同时，将非平稳线性老虎机中的参数漂移与上下文线性老虎机中的模型误设定联系起来。这一联系使我们能够利用误设定自适应学习方法，为一般性的时变决策集获得动态遗憾保证。对于已知的路径长度预算 $P_T$，我们在遗忘型参数路径下为一般紧致、自适应且非预测性的决策集建立了这些保证，并针对 $K$ 臂上下文问题（摘要内容在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出一种分块规约方法，将非平稳线性老虎机中的参数漂移转化为上下文线性老虎机中的模型误设定问题，从而为一般性时变决策集建立了动态遗憾保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a blockwise reduction that connects parameter drift in non-stationary linear bandits to model misspecification in contextual linear bandits, thereby establishing dynamic-regret guarantees for general time-varying decision sets.
